identity.goals_in_their_words: I want my energy and focus back, and I don't want my dad's heart disease.
identity.motivation: Father had a heart attack at 58; reads everything; wears a Whoop daily; wants the data to tell him exactly what to do.

known_conditions: none diagnosed; borderline BP noted at last GP visit (138/86, untreated)

family_history.cardiovascular: Father — myocardial infarction at 58, now on a statin. Paternal uncle — bypass in his 60s.
family_history.note: Strong first-degree cardiometabolic history — directly relevant to the genome findings.

diet.pattern: Omnivore, eats out / orders in ~6x/week (founder schedule)
diet.whole_grains: some; lots of white rice + naan when ordering in

drinks.coffee_timing: 2 before noon, often 1-2 after 3pm during crunch

exercise.structured_cardio_zone2: essentially none — <30 min/week of steady aerobic work
exercise.self_described: Was fit in my 20s. Now it's the first thing that gets dropped when work spikes.

sleep_recovery.sleep_quality: wakes unrefreshed; phone in bed; mind racing about work
sleep_recovery.self_described: I'm tired all day and wired all night.

stress_mood_mind.phq2_gad2: GAD-2 mildly elevated (work anxiety); PHQ-2 negative
stress_mood_mind.practices: none consistent; tried meditation apps, didn't stick; no breathwork
stress_mood_mind.self_described: Always-on. The company is in a fundraise. I can't switch off.

energy_hormonal.afternoon_crash: daily, ~3pm — usually fixes it with another coffee
energy_hormonal.libido: lower than a few years ago

environment_substances.city_aqi: Bengaluru — moderate; frequent travel to Delhi (high AQI) and SE Asia

constraints.biggest_obstacle: time and travel — anything that needs a fixed daily slot tends to fail
constraints.kitchen_access: cook/help at home; orders in on workdays
